# POSIFY - Enterprise POS Platform

## What is Posify?
Posify is a modern Point of Sale (POS) platform built for African businesses. It combines sales processing, inventory management, staff management, reporting, and analytics into one unified system.

## Core Features
- Sales & checkout with cash, M-PESA, and card payments
- Real-time inventory management with stock alerts and expiry tracking
- Cashier and staff management with role-based permissions
- Advanced reporting and analytics dashboards
- Multi-branch support for growing businesses
- Offline mode with automatic cloud sync
- Receipt generation and printing
- Time tracking and shift management

## Pricing Plans
- Starter: KES 999/month — single location, 1 admin, 2 cashiers
- Professional: KES 2,499/month — up to 10 branches, up to 10 users
- Enterprise: KES 4,999/month — unlimited branches and users, API access

## Free Trial
15-day free trial available. No credit card required.

## Target Market
Small to enterprise businesses in Kenya and across Africa, including retail shops, supermarkets, clinics, pharmacies, restaurants, and service businesses.

## Integrations
- M-PESA
- Email notifications (SendGrid)
- Cloud storage for backups
